research.title: Lord Chris Holmes on Turning Ambition into Action
research.summary: After losing his sight at the age of 14, Lord Chris Holmes became one of Britain’s most successful Paralympic swimmers and went on to build a career spanning law, public service, and technology policy. In a Talks at GS conversation with Matthew Pomfret, global head of Controllers Risk & Regulatory Control at Goldman Sachs, Lord Holmes reflects on the teams that made his achievements possible, the mindset required to lead under pressure, and the opportunity to build a more inclusive future through innovation.

research.title: How Hedge Funds Are Navigating Stock Market Volatility
research.summary: Hedge funds are reducing risk and hedging their portfolios with short positions amid volatility in technology stocks, says Vincent Lin, co-head of Prime Insights and Analytics in Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities. While “faster money” types, including hedge funds and momentum strategies, are being more cautious, "slower money" investment among retirement savers remains historically elevated. In The Markets podcast, Lin also highlights opportunities in hyperscalers and in defensive sectors like healthcare.

research.title: What Will Determine the Durability of the AI Investment Cycle?
research.summary: Will AI-related market stresses and regulatory uncertainty stall investment in AI? Demand, capital, and power supply may determine whether the investment cycle endures, Social Capital CEO Chamath Palihapitiya and Eric Sheridan of Goldman Sachs Research say on the Exchanges podcast.

research.title: Can Treasuries Still Protect Your Portfolio?
research.summary: When stocks fall, investors often turn to government bonds. Our Global Head of Macro Strategy Matthew Hornbach looks at whether the market's favorite hedge has lost its appeal. Read more insights from Morgan Stanley.
